    AI Overview
    conversation
    /ˌkänvərˈsāSHən/
    A conversation is an informal, interactive, and often spontaneous exchange of ideas, sentiments, or information between two or more people, primarily conducted through speech. It is essential for human connection, relying on active listening, non-verbal cues (like smiles or tone), and a 50/50 balance of speaking and listening. 
    Key elements for effective and engaging conversations include: 
    • Active Participation: Using open-ended questions (starting with "how" or "what") encourages deeper dialogue, while closed-ended questions often lead to brief, one-word answers.
    • Other-Centered Focus: Cultivating genuine curiosity about the other person and using positive non-verbal cues (eye contact, smiling) builds rapport
      .
    • Storytelling: Sharing narratives and emotional experiences (even embarrassing ones) creates a stronger, deeper connection than just sharing facts.
    • Balanced Exchange: A good conversation often follows a 50/50 rhythm, allowing both participants to contribute equally. 
    Is the Conversation Reliable?
    If you are referring to the news platform, The Conversation U.S., it is considered highly reliable. It publishes articles written by academic and research experts, edited by journalists to provide evidence-based, informative content to the public. 
    Different Types of Conversation
    Conversations can range from informal, daily chats (like sharing, listening, and storytelling) to more structured, professional discussions, sometimes referred to as dialogues.

    What is the meaning of conversation?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    conversation
    /ˌkänvərˈsāSHən/
    A conversation is an informal, interactive exchange of thoughts, feelings, or ideas between two or more people, primarily through spoken words. It is a social, back-and-forth communication process used to build relationships, share information, and foster understanding. Common synonyms include dialogue, chat, talk, discussion, and banter. 
    Key Aspects and Usage Examples 
    • Informal Exchange: A casual, in-person, or phone conversation with a friend.
    • Topic Discussion: A deep or detailed conversation about a specific topic, such as politics or work.
    • Social Interaction: "Striking up a conversation" with a stranger.
    • Verbal/Non-Verbal: Can include spoken language or sign language.
    • Idiomatic Usage: Holding a conversation, carrying on a conversation, or having a "conversation" that means a discussion. 
    Synonyms of Conversation 
    • Dialogue
    • Chat / Chatting
    • Talk / Talking
    • Discussion
    • Interchange
    • Banter
    • Communication
    • Chinwag (informal)
    • Pow-wow (informal) 
    Contextual Definitions 
    • General: An informal talk.
    • Specific: A formal or informal conference (e.g., "peace conversations").
    • Etymology: Derived from the Latin conversari, meaning "to associate with".
    • Archaic: Manner of living or behavior.
